llm_output.markdown_excerpt: [Skip to content](https://napi.rs/#main-content) # Building pre-compiled Node.js addons in Rust ### Seamless WebAssembly integration, safer API designs with lifetime management, and simplified cross-compilation for broader platform support. [Get Started](https://napi.rs/docs/introduction/getting-started) [![GitHub logo](https://napi.rs/assets/github.svg)GitHub](https://github.com/napi-rs/napi-rs) Rust CratesC/C++Node.jsNode.js addonWASI moduleTypeScript typesnpm packages ![NAPI-RS Logo](https://napi.rs/img/favicon.png) ## Live WASM + NAPI-RS Demo ### This is a sample app using NAPI-RS WebAssembly. You can transform the image to webp, jpeg or avif with different quality. Transform Image App TS Code ``` import { Transformer } from '@napi-rs/image' export async function transform() { const imageResponse = await fetch( 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/5d/ISS-45_EVA-2_%28a%29_Scott_Kelly.jpg' ) const imageBytes = await imageResponse.arrayBuffer() const transformer = new Transformer(imageBytes) const webp = await transformer.toWebp() } ``` Rust Code ``` use napi::bindgen_prelude::*; use napi_derive::napi; #[napi] pub struct Transformer { inner: Uint8Array, } #[napi] impl
